issue.title: rsyslogd UDP server is rendered as `null`

failure.body:
#### Description

We found a timing issue for script [rsyslog-config.sh](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/files/image_config/rsyslog/rsyslog-config.sh)
If the `lo` interface is not ready before below call, we will get `null` for `udp_server_ip`. As a result, the `$UDPServerAddress` in `/etc/rsyslog.conf` will be `null`, and `rsyslog` service will not work as expected. We will get no log for any container.
```
if [[ ($NUM_ASIC -gt 1) ]]; then
    udp_server_ip=$(ip -o -4 addr list docker0 | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
else
    udp_server_ip=$(ip -j -4 addr list lo scope host | jq -r -M '.[0].addr_info[0].local')
fi
```
#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
The issue can only be reproed on a few device.
1. Reboot device to regenerate `/etc/rsyslog.conf`
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
`$UDPServerAddress` in `/etc/rsyslog.conf` is null.

#### Describe the results you expected:

`$UDPServerAddress` in `/etc/rsyslog.conf` should be `<IP>` (single ASIC)

resolution.title: rsyslog to start after interfaces-config
resolution.description:
Fixes #12408

#### Why I did it
We are running into https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/12408 very frequently.
This results in no syslogs from any containers as rsyslog server could not start.
some of the sonic-mgmt scripts look for log statements and error out if log is not present.

`Interfaces-config` service configures the loopback interface along with other interfaces. `rsyslog-config` reads ip address of loopback interface and generates `/etc/rsyslog.conf`. When this race condition happens, `lo` interface ip is not yet programmed and `rsyslog-config` ends up writing UDP server as `null` in `/etc/rsyslog.conf`.

#### How I did it
rsyslog-config service is started after interfaces-config service.
#### How to verify it
Did multiple reboots and verified that `$UDPServerAddress` is valid.
